passage:
During music class, the teacher played an old song. Most students did not know it, but one student, Jenny, suddenly smiled.
"My grandmother sings this," she said.
The teacher asked Jenny to sing along. Jenny was shy, but she tried. Her voice was small at first, then stronger.
After class, several students asked Jenny about the song. She told them her grandmother sang it while cooking. The words were about waiting for spring.
The next week, Jenny brought her grandmother to school. The old woman taught the class the song properly.
The students learned that music is not only something found online. Sometimes it lives quietly in families, waiting for someone young to carry it forward.
